From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>

Hi Alex / Marissa —

Adding the vuln management details here so FinHealth has a single reference. Attached: Vuln_Management_Process_v1.2.docx and PenTest_Scope_Template.docx.

Summary (high level):
- Scanning cadence: internal CI-integrated SAST + dependency scanning on every PR; weekly internal dynamic scans; external authenticated/unauthenticated scans monthly.
- Pen testing: third-party: annual full-scope test plus targeted assessments for major releases or customer-impacting features.
- Triage & SLAs:
  - Critical (RCE/data exfil): initial triage within 48 hours; mitigation plan within 7 calendar days.
  - High (auth bypass, privilege escalation): initial triage within 3 business days; mitigation plan within 30 calendar days.
  - Medium/Low: mitigations prioritized by risk and scheduled in upcoming sprints (usually 30-90 days depending on backlog).
- Disclosure & reporting: we provide a redacted pen test report for vendor review. For customers with additional requirements we can provide an enhanced report under NDA and coordinate a 1:1 technical review with our security team.
- Fix verification: we run targeted re-scans and include the fix verification in the follow-up report; raw exploit PoCs are never shared in vendor-facing documents.

If FinHealth needs changes to the scope or a faster SLA for critical items, we can discuss contractual SLAs as part of Dedicated/Private options.

Rishi
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Vuln_Management_Process_v1.2.docx, PenTest_Scope_Template.docx
